training.note: One-minute smoke-training run (configs/classic_intro_32ray_accel.json via `gravity-lab-rl train --duration-seconds 60`) on Easy track 0 (Intro) / 100cc only. Same setup as the original 8-ray sensor smoke run, but with the obstacle-ray sensor widened from 8 to 32 rays and a new per-component acceleration region added (28 base + 32 rays + 12 acceleration = 72 inputs). Best-checkpoint tracking found no improvement over the final state in this short a run, so best.gdp and final.gdp are identical. This is a pipeline smoke result on a single easy track, not a general performance claim.

reference_evaluation.note: Deterministic same-track evaluation (Easy track 0, Intro); not a general performance claim across other tracks or leagues.
